We need propose retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <=9999 (we can't check price but assume common reagents). Need to output JSON route.

We need to find disconnections. Target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Structure: a tolyl sulfonamide attached to phenyl with a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonyl-phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline (with NH2 on aniline). Could be built via sulfonylation of aniline with p-toluenesulfonyl chloride? Actually sulfonamide: NS(=O)(=O) attached to phenyl ring (the sulfonyl attached to phenyl). The sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the tolyl phenyl? Wait SMILES: Cc1ccc(N S(=O)(=O) c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)N c3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1. So the sulfonamide nitrogen attached to tolyl ring (para-methyl phenyl) and sulfonyl attached to second phenyl ring (c2...). So it's a sulfonamide linking two aryl groups.

Thus retrosynthesis: disconnection at sulfonamide N-S bond: could form via sulfonyl chloride reacting with aniline (aryl amine). So precursor 1: p-toluidine (4-methylaniline) (SMILES: Cc1ccc(N)cc1). Precursor 2: aryl sulfonyl chloride: 4-(...?) Actually the sulfonyl attached to phenyl bearing the unsaturated amide side chain. So we need 4-(...)-phenylsulfonyl chloride (SMILES: ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(... )cc1). The side chain is /C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N attached at para position? In SMILES: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonyl. So the phenyl ring with side chain at para relative to sulfonyl? Not important.

Thus step1: sulfonyl chloride + p-toluidine -> target (sulfonamide formation). That's one step.

Now need to get sulfonyl chloride precursor. Could be made from corresponding sulfonic acid via thionyl chloride, but we can also purchase aryl sulfonyl chloride commercially. Likely 4-(E-... )-phenylsulfonyl chloride may be not common. Alternative: make via sulfonation of the phenyl with side chain? Might be expensive.

Alternative disconnection: form the α,β-unsaturated amide via condensation (Knoevenagel) then amidation. Could break C=C bond? Use Heck coupling? Simpler: start from 4-iodophenyl sulfonyl chloride and do Heck coupling with acrylamide? Might be complex.

Maybe better route: first form the amide: aniline (aniline) + acryloyl chloride? Actually need trans-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline. Could be made via condensation of aniline with cinnamoyl chloride? Wait cinnamoyl chloride is ClC(=O)C=Cc1ccccc1. But we need C(=O)N attached to aniline, and the double bond attached to phenyl ring (the same phenyl as sulfonyl). Actually the side chain is attached to phenyl ring: phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline. So we could start from 4-(E)-cinnamoyl chloride attached to phenyl? Actually the phenyl is the same ring bearing the sulfonyl. So we need to attach the side chain to that phenyl via a vinyl group. Could be done via Heck coupling of 4-bromo phenyl sulfonyl chloride with acrylamide? That seems plausible.

But maybe we can purchase the phenyl sulfonyl chloride with the side chain already present (i.e., 4-(E)-cinnamoyl phenyl sulfonyl chloride). Might be not common.

Given constraints, we can propose a 3-step route where all leaves are common: p-toluidine, 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride, acrylamide (CH2=CH-CO-NH2) and aniline? Wait we need aniline attached to amide nitrogen, not NH2. The amide is N-phenyl (aniline). So we need N-phenylcinnamamide? Actually the amide is C(=O)N-Ph(NH2). So we need N-phenylcinnamamide (cinnamoyl anilide). Could be made by reacting cinnamoyl chloride with aniline. Cinnamoyl chloride is commercially available. Then we need to attach that amide side chain to phenyl sulfonyl chloride via Heck coupling? Actually we need phenyl-sulfonyl attached to the vinyl carbon of the cinnamoyl moiety. The cinnamoyl part is CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph(NH2). The phenyl-sulfonyl is attached to the phenyl ring of the cinnamoyl (the phenyl that is part of the cinnamoyl). Wait cinnamoyl is phenyl-CH=CH-CO-. In our target, the phenyl attached to the vinyl is the same phenyl that also bears the sulfonyl group. So we need a phenyl ring with both sulfonyl and the vinyl side chain para to each other. So we could start from 4-bromo-phenyl sulfonyl chloride, do Heck coupling with acrylamide (CH2=CH-CO-NHPh(NH2)?) Actually we need the amide attached to the vinyl carbon, not the acrylamide. The Heck coupling forms C-C bond between aryl bromide and alkene, giving trans-aryl-alkene. So we could take 4-bromo-phenylsulfonyl chloride and react with N-phenylacrylamide (i.e., CH2=CH-CO-NH-Ph(NH2)). That would give the desired trans-aryl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph(NH2). Then sulfonamide formation with p-toluidine gives final product.

Thus steps:

1. Synthesize N-phenylacrylamide (cinnamamide) via amidation: cinnamoyl chloride + aniline -> N-phenylcinnamamide. Cinnamoyl chloride is commercially available. Aniline is available.

2. Heck coupling: 4-bromo-phenylsulfonyl chloride + N-phenylcinnamamide -> intermediate (aryl sulfonyl chloride attached to trans-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph(NH2)). Use Pd-catalyzed Heck.

4-bromo-phenylsulfonyl chloride is commercially available? Possibly 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride (bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride) is common.

3. Sulfonamide formation: intermediate + p-toluidine -> target.

All leaves: p-toluidine, aniline, cinnamoyl chloride, 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride. All are common and cheap.

Now need to produce JSON route.

We need template IDs for each reaction. We don't have them; we can search. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria to find appropriate templates: for amide formation (acyl chloride + amine), for Heck coupling (aryl bromide + alkene), for sulfonamide formation (sulfonyl chloride + amine). Let's search.


We will call search_template_catalog_by_criteria for each.

First amide formation: functional_groups_broken=["acyl_chloride"], functional_groups_formed=["amide"] maybe.
